name: the-free-dictionary
title: The Free Dictionary (TFD)
description: Search for words in The Free Dictionary (TFD) website

commands.name: manual-search
commands.title: Search Word
commands.description:
Enter a word.
You'll then be redirected on TFD website to see its definition
commands.subtitle: Enter a word and search it on TFD

commands.name: selection-search
commands.title: Search Selected Word
commands.description: Redirect on TFD website to see the definition of the word that is currently selected.
commands.subtitle: Directly search your current selection in TFD

commands.name: search-history
commands.title: Searched Words History
commands.description: View your search history and quickly access previously searched words on TFD.
commands.subtitle: Access your previously searched words
